fix_subject: Support delimiters consisting of multiple bytes, and non-ASCII delimiter, quote and comment characters in COPY TO CSV
pr_title: Merge #26614: Support delimiters consisting of multiple bytes, and non-ASCII delimiter, quote and comment characters in COPY TO CSV

labels.summary: COPY TO CSV raised an internal error for bytes 0x80 and above because the quoting table was indexed with a signed char, and wrote only the first byte of a multi-byte or non-ASCII delimiter, producing files that could not be read back.
